rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an amount of time or the time span of a situation.

example.english: The duration of this film is not very long.
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 ge3 si4 gaan3 m4 syun3 coeng4

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress a particular stretch or span of time.

example.english: We have to wait for a duration before we can enter.
example.traditional: 我哋要等一段時間先可以入場。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dang2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this for the bounded duration of a named event or situation, especially in expressions meaning 'during the duration'.

example.english: During the duration, all staff have to stay at the company.
example.traditional: 期間，所有員工都要留喺公司。
example.jyutping: kei4 gaan1 so2 jau5 jyun4 gung1 dou1 jiu3 lau4 hai2 gung1 si1
